# ModelRenderable

> **Kind:** component · **Registry:** host · **Folder:** [`src/view/components/`](../folders/src-view-components.md)
> **Source:** [`src/view/components/model_renderable.h`](../../../src/view/components/model_renderable.h)

## Summary

Draws the ModelC held by another entity at this entity's Transform, tinted.

## Description

Per-entity host component read by the renderer's ModelPass (view<const Transform, const ModelRenderable>). `model` is the entity returned by ModelManager::load / add, which holds the GPU ModelC. Emplaced by spawnBox (BoxRingSys, BoxThrowerSys, DebugMenuSys, VRControlSys), ModelLineupSys, VRControlSys (hands), SphereViewSys (bar and dot parts), WorldViewSys (world body mirrors) and the scene component `ModelRenderable` (register_view.cpp), which needs the renderer's ModelManager. Only meaningful in the host registry of dynamical (world registries use ModelRef instead).

## Scene JSON

"ModelRenderable": { "path": "<file under resources/>", "tint": [r, g, b, a] (default [1,1,1,1]) }. Unknown keys throw (JsonFields::finish). Throws ComponentError if there is no ModelManager (no renderer) or the model cannot be loaded (/path). Saved back as { "tint": [...] } only (the path is not saved).

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model` | `entt::entity` | (constructor argument) | Host entity holding the ModelC; entt::null draws nothing (renderer side). |
| `tint` | `glm::vec4` | glm::vec4(1.f) | RGBA multiplier. |
